rows: Rhizome (underground stem with nodes — NOT a root)
Why does dried ginger taste different than fresh?
Dehydration converts gingerols → shogaols (more pungent, different character)
Why is turmeric bioavailability so poor?
Hydrophobic, rapidly glucuronidated in liver; piperine helps via CYP3A4 inhibition
Black pepper's piperine inhibits CYP3A4 → 20× more curcumin reaches bloodstream — traditional Indian cooking discovered this empirically
Can I substitute galangal for ginger?
Not in SE Asian cuisine — different flavor role. Ginger in a Thai curry will taste wrong.
Is curcumin the miracle compound claimed?
Mechanistically plausible; clinical evidence weak due to bioavailability; PAINS interference corrupted early research
Named for Aframomum melegueta (grains of paradise) — medieval European pepper substitute, now forgotten
